headline: Liverpool's unbeaten CL run ends at Fenerbahce; Madrid push on
paragraphs: Liverpool lost 3-2 at Fenerbahce on Wednesday, their first Champions League defeat of the season after twice taking the lead. Sky Sports, the Guardian and Opta Analyst all reported the same collapse, with Muriqi completing the comeback for a Fenerbahce side coached by former Liverpool forward Dirk Kuyt. Manager Andoni Iraola said the goals conceded were, in his own words, cheap and messy, according to Sky's live blog.

Real Madrid kept their perfect Champions League record, coming from behind twice to beat AEK Athens 3-2 on a late Valverde strike, per the Guardian. Separately, Real Madrid's move for Manchester United's 16-year-old academy prospect JJ Gabriel is now reported by three outlets — Sky Sports, the Guardian and Transfermarkt — as close to a verbal agreement, though nothing is official. The Guardian notes United could consider legal action if they believe rules on approaching the teenager were broken, so this stays a reported deal, not a completed one.

In the same round of fixtures, Arsenal led Slavia Prague behind a Madueke goal, and Manchester City were still trying to break down RB Leipzig, according to Sky's live coverage, with the Guardian's live blog following both matches too; no final scores were reported. Separately, BBC Sport's gossip column linked Manchester United with a 'surprise' move for City defender Rayan Ait-Nouri — a single-source rumour, not corroborated elsewhere.
